deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=chumbleys --branch=main --commit-dirty=true && node ~/site-kit/bin/site-kit.mjs submit
deploy.auth: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID (unset CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL — the global key stopped working 2026-09-23)
deploy.notes: build.mjs copies an allow-list of the public files into dist/ and dates the sitemap (site-kit lastmod); deploy dist/, never the root — a root deploy publishes CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md, site.json, wrangler.toml and migrations/ (Pages ignores .assetsignore; ~/fleet/docs/gotchas.md); run from the repo root so Functions ship (wrangler reads ./functions and wrangler.toml there); secrets bind at deploy time; the last step submits the changes to IndexNow, Search Console and Bing — commit .indexnow.json after
